findings.message: The diff changes the `view status` row to say "Warns when the installed Antigravity plugin MCP configuration drifts or its executable cannot resolve." `handle_status` in clutch/__main__.py never calls `antigravity.doctor_finding`. Only `doctor.check`, which `host doctor` runs, emits that warning, and the ticket asks only for the `host doctor` row to change. The run guide now gives operators wrong information about `view status`.
findings.paved_road: Restore the original `view status` row text and keep the Antigravity drift sentence only in the `host doctor` row.
